LIMITATION_OF_LIABILITY.source: Common Paper Cloud Service Agreement (CSA) v1.0
LIMITATION_OF_LIABILITY.baseline_text: Neither party's aggregate liability under this Agreement will exceed the amounts paid or payable by Customer during the twelve (12) month period immediately preceding the claim. Neither party will be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or any loss of profits, revenue, data, or business opportunities.
fair_principles: Liability is mutual and capped at 12 months of fees
Both parties share the same limitation structure

INDEMNIFICATION.baseline_text: Provider will indemnify Customer against third-party claims alleging that the Service infringes intellectual property rights. Customer will indemnify Provider against third-party claims arising from Customer's use of the Service in violation of this Agreement. The indemnifying party will have sole control of the defense and settlement.
fair_principles: Provider covers IP infringement of its own service

DATA_PRIVACY.baseline_text: Provider will process Customer Data only in accordance with Customer's documented instructions. Provider will implement and maintain appropriate technical and organizational security measures. Provider will promptly notify Customer of any data breach. Upon termination, Provider will delete or return all Customer Data within 30 days.
fair_principles: Breach notification is mandatory and prompt
Data returned or deleted on termination

IP_TRANSFER.baseline_text: Each party retains all rights in its pre-existing intellectual property. Customer retains all rights in Customer Data. Provider retains all rights in the Service. No intellectual property rights are transferred by this Agreement except the limited license rights expressly granted.
fair_principles: No broad IP assignment — only license grants
Customer retains ownership of their data
Provider retains ownership of the service
Pre-existing IP remains with original owner

TERMINATION.baseline_text: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice. Either party may terminate for cause if the other party materially breaches and fails to cure within thirty (30) days of written notice. Upon termination, Provider will make Customer Data available for export for at least 30 days.
fair_principles: Convenience termination available to both parties

AUTO_RENEWAL.baseline_text: The initial term will automatically renew for successive one-year periods unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days before the end of the then-current term.
fair_principles: Either party can opt out with 30 days notice
Renewal terms are clearly stated upfront

ARBITRATION.baseline_text: Any dispute arising under this Agreement will be resolved by binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognized arbitration body under its then-current rules. The arbitration will take place in a mutually agreed location. Each party will bear its own costs, and the parties will share arbitration fees equally.
fair_principles: Shared costs — not one-sided fee burden

NON_COMPETE.baseline_text: During the term and for a period of twelve (12) months following termination, Employee agrees not to directly compete with the Company within the same geographic market. This restriction applies only to the specific business line in which the Employee was engaged.
fair_principles: Limited to specific business line, not all industries

CONFIDENTIALITY.baseline_text: Each party agrees to hold the other party's Confidential Information in confidence using at least the same degree of care it uses for its own confidential information, but no less than reasonable care. Confidential Information excludes information that is publicly available, independently developed, or rightfully received from a third party.

GOVERNING_LAW.baseline_text: This Agreement will be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the state specified in the Order Form, without regard to conflicts of law principles. Each party consents to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts located in the governing jurisdiction.
fair_principles: Conflicts of law exclusion for clarity

PAYMENT_TERMS.baseline_text: Customer will pay all fees specified in the applicable Order Form within thirty (30) days of the invoice date. Late payments will accrue interest at the lesser of 1.5% per month or the maximum rate permitted by law.
fair_principles: Interest capped at reasonable rate or legal maximum
Fees specified in advance via order form

WARRANTY.baseline_text: Provider warrants that the Service will perform materially in accordance with the applicable documentation during the term. If the Service fails to meet this warranty, Provider will, at its option, correct the non-conformance or refund the fees paid for the affected period.
fair_principles: Warranty applies during the full term

FORCE_MAJEURE.baseline_text: Neither party will be liable for any failure or delay in performing its obligations where such failure or delay results from circumstances beyond the reasonable control of that party, including but not limited to acts of God, natural disasters, war, terrorism, pandemics, or government actions. The affected party must provide prompt notice and use reasonable efforts to mitigate the impact.

ASSIGNMENT.baseline_text: Neither party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party, except in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all of the assigning party's assets.
